title: Homepage hero composition
question: Which poker-table composition should carry forward from the approved direction?

options.label: Centred held fan
options.thesis: The five-card fan held at the lower centre, read straight on.
options.viewport: Wide desktop first viewport: fan leads, table and opponents recede behind it.
options.risk: Can read as a conventional hero if the hand loses physical scale.

options.label: Intimate close fan
options.thesis: A closer, more overlapping fan with the hand gripping from the left.
options.viewport: Wide desktop first viewport: larger cards, deep shadows, minimal background detail.
options.risk: Overlap may cost legibility of the outer cards.

options.label: Environmental fan
options.thesis: A fan set off-centre with opponents and table storytelling visible.
options.viewport: Wide desktop first viewport: the hand leads while the room proves the stakes.
options.risk: Environmental detail can compete with the hand if it gets too sharp.
